text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Copano Rickey wasn't feeling well, I 
brought her to the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for making you worry. I've got the 
infirmary all set up, so everything should 
be fine once you get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This place is... what is it, the air feels 
so suffocating.

text_block_list.name: Azure Dragon & White Tiger
text_block_list.text: Phew... Myuu...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A tiny dragon and... a white tiger?! 
Wh-What?! Who are these little guys?!

text_block_list.name: Dark Feng Shui Master
text_block_list.text:
Aah-hah-hah! I am the Feng Shui Master of 
Darkness!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: A dark feng shui master?!

text_block_list.name: Dark Feng Shui Master
text_block_list.text:
I have ravaged the dragon veins and 
disrupted the qi... The power of the Four 
Gods gathered here has waned! Once I 
defeat you, the world will be mine!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Using feng shui to make people suffer is 
unforgivable!! Hold on, everyone! I'll 
save you right now!"

text_block_list.name: Dark Feng Shui Master
text_block_list.text: Like I'd let you! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

"...Kei, it's Rickey. Remember... instead 
of cowering in fear of bad luck..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Learn how to become lucky"... Right! 
You're so right, Dragon God!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I can align the disrupted qi and 
channel it properly into my body! Lend me 
your power, feng shui!!

text_block_list.name: Dark Feng Shui Master
text_block_list.text:
I-Impossible! The Four Gods are regaining 
their pow—ack, GYAAAAAAHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: A dream...?! Phew, my heart was racing!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Don't be afraid of being unlucky, huh? 
Ehehe, I feel like a weight's been lifted 
off my shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Azure Dragon & White Tiger
text_block_list.text: Pyuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
!? Everyone, don't step forward, it's 
dangerous!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "...Gasp?! A-A dream...?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...If only I had been my usual self, I'm 
sure I could have done my best even in the 
dream. Jeez..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to resolve the problem in her 
dream, a lingering Copano Rickey didn't 
seem to rest very well...
